senses.gloss:
पौंश्चलीय पौंश्चलीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुंश्-
चली), belonging or relating to harlots, meretricious.
पौंश्चलेय, अस्, m., Ved. the son of a harlot.
पौंश्चल्य, अम्, n. female incontinency, harlotry.

पौंसवन पौंसवन, अम्, n. (fr. पुं-स-
वन), one of the Saṃskāras or essential ceremonies
of the Hindū religion; a religious observance held
when signs of a living conception take place (in
order to obtain male offspring).

पौंस्न पौंस्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. पुंस्), worthy
of or fit for a man; relating to or good for man;
manly, virile; human; (अम्), n. manhood, manly
strength.

पौंस्य, अम्, n., Ved. manhood, virility, manly
power; the courage or virtue of a man, a manly
deed (Sāy. = बल); (अस्, &c.), masculine.

पौनःपुनिक पौनःपुनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
पुनः-पुनः), frequently reiterated, repeated again
and again.

पौनःपुन्य, अम्, n. frequent reiteration, con-
stant repetition; (एन), ind. again and again, re-
peatedly.

पौनराधेयिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-आधेय),
Ved. relating to the rite of replacing or renewing the
sacrificial fire; [cf. पुनर्-आधेयिक.]

पौनरुक्त, अम्, n. (fr. पुनर्-उक्त), repe-
tition, tautology.

पौनरुक्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa Ukthādi to
Pāṇ. IV. 2, 60.

पौनर्नव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-नवा), relat-
ing or belonging to the plant Boerhavia Procumbens.

पौनर्भव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. पुनर्-भू), re-
peated, additional; relating or belonging to a widow
who has married a second husband; (अस्), m. the
son of a widow remarried, the offspring of a twice-
married woman by her second husband, one of the
sons or heirs admitted by the old Hindū law; पौ-
नर्भवो भर्ता, a woman's second husband.

पौनर्भविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-भव),
relating to regeneration.
